CREATE_VIEW_Query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW USER_RATING_VIEW_DATA AS
    WITH json_view AS (
    SELECT from_json(json_raw.data,
                     'ARRAY<STRUCT<bggId: BIGINT, rating: DECIMAL(3,1), username: STRING>>') array
    FROM (SELECT java_method('org.spark.service.rest.QueryRESTDataService', 'getRESTDataDocument',
        'http://localhost:8090/DSA-SQL-JDBCService/rest/ratings/UserRatingView')
        as data) json_raw
    )
    select v.*
    FROM json_view LATERAL VIEW explode(json_view.array) AS v
